description_zh: AV在Toland街与Hudson大道交叉口左转时，另一辆车从左侧驶入交叉口并撞上AV左侧面。选AV为ego测其左转时检测侧向直行冲突的能力，对方为NPC，位置cross，行为junction_cross。

source_snippets: While the Waymo AV was making a left turn onto Hudson Avenue, a passenger vehicle proceeded into the intersection from the left and made contact with the left side of the Waymo AV.
DATE OF ACCIDENT: 02/24/2023, TIME OF ACCIDENT: 12:15 AM
LIGHTING: A. DAYLIGHT (但实际时间为12:15 AM，按时间推断为夜间)
evidence.reason: 双方均为移动车辆，AV左转，另一车从左侧直行通过路口，碰撞有交互。现有词汇表可用junction_cross+ cross位置表达。时间取12:15 AM为night，天气clear。
